newsitem.title: USA: Kaiser anticipates Q3 loss up to $0.20/shr.
newsitem.headline: Kaiser anticipates Q3 loss up to $0.20/shr.

text.p: Kaiser Aluminum Corp said Monday it will report a net loss ranging between $0.14 and $0.20 per share in the third quarter ended September 30.
It attributed the anticipated loss to low recent and current prices for alumina and primary aluminum as well as lower can stock shipments and increased alumina production costs.

Kaiser said that if fourth-quarter market prices of primary aluminum do not increase from recent levels, its net loss in this year's fourth quarter could "substantially" exceed the third-quarter loss.
In last year's third quarter, the company reported earnings per share of $0.13.
Kaiser produces alumina, primary aluminum and semi-fabricated aluminum products.
